text:
leo: FYI  EdgeSight (acct ES-204) showing steady drop in active calls to the insights endpoint (~47% down). Renewal in 13 days and customer mentioned evaluating a downgrade to Standard. Marking as at-risk.

sarah: ARR and renewal contact?

leo: $62k ARR. Renewal owner is toni@edgesight.ai. Onboarding score 44/100. Missed the last two enablement sessions. NPS last month = 4.

mike: Any open tickets or infra issues?

leo: One support thread SUP-411 about inconsistent semantic matches, and a billing question about token variance. No SLO breaches. Usage shift looks like they trimmed calls to avoid costs.

sarah: Let's avoid discounts early. Propose two-track play: 1) Optimize (recommended): rapid triage + prompt/usage audit + reversible config patch (batching + prefix caching + prompt shortener) + 7-day canary. 2) Downgrade path: feature mapping doc + migration checklist + rollback script, so API parity & expectations are clear. Tie any credits to completing the Optimize track.

toni: I need a one-pager to send to our CTO. Keep it exec friendly: one paragraph on risk, bullets for the Optimize track, and a clear downgrade mapping table.

mike: Draft checklist and owners below. Short timeline: 5 days to show impact.

```
- outreach (owner: toni) within 12h: one-pager + 3Q feedback form link
- schedule 30m triage call (owner: leo) within 48h
- prompt & token audit (owner: mike) deliver in 24h after triage
- reversible config patch: batching + KV prefix cache + prompt shortener (owner: mike)
- run 7-day canary and measure: p95 latency, token delta, cache hit-rate (owner: mike)
- downgrade mapping doc (owner: sarah): list endpoints impacted, feature tradeoffs, estimated migration time
- conditional offer: 21-day usage credits if Optimize track completed (owner: toni)
- escalation: no reply in 36h -> CSM lead (owner: toni)
```

leo: Quick sample commands I'll run to collect signals: 
```
# token distribution
SELECT endpoint, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM usage.events WHERE account='ES-204' AND ts>now()-14d GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 8;

# cache hit-rate
SELECT kv_cache_hit, count(*) FROM infra.metrics WHERE account_id='ES-204' AND ts>now()-7d GROUP BY kv_cache_hit;
```

mike: I'll start the audit now and post preliminary top-3 token sinks by EOD. Early suspicion: repeated session metadata + lengthy system prompt. Quick remediation often reduces tokens 15-30%.

sarah: For the downgrade mapping please include: feature parity table, example API responses with differences, a recommended migration window, and a rollback command. Keep it one page.

toni: Sending the outreach now with the 3Q survey: https://forms.redwood.company/s/edgesight-3q (paste in the email). I'll cc their engineering lead.

leo: If they accept the triage, propose Wed 10am PT. If they decline or ghost, we open the downgrade doc and map exact feature delta so their execs can weigh fast.

mike: Suggestion: prepare a reversible shim that toggles caching and batching flags. CLI example for the shim: 
```
redwood config apply --account ES-204 --patch \"{\"batching\":true,\"kv_prefix_cache\":true,\"prompt_trim\":true}\" --dry-run
```

toni: Good. I'll make the conditional credit clear in the one-pager (credits pay out after we see >12% sustained token reduction during the canary).

cse_bot: Account snapshot linked: https://redwood.app/account/ES-204/health | onboarding=44/100, last_enablement=55d ago, NPS=4. Save-plan artifact created and attached to timeline.

mike: Posting initial audit notes by EOD: identified 3 endpoints responsible for ~70% of tokens, sample fixes + estimated token savings included.

sarah: If Optimize shows clear wins, propose a 3-month renewal extension conversation with conditionally reduced unit-costs (not an up-front discount). If they insist on downgrade, provide migration estimate and run a migration dry-run.

toni: Thanks team. Owners: toni (outreach + exec one-pager), leo (triage + timeline), mike (audit + patch + metrics), sarah (downgrade mapping + exec comms). I'll update the account timeline after I send the outreach.

leo: Outreach sent and meeting proposed. Posting meeting link here once confirmed.

cse_bot: Reminder set: follow-up ping in 36h if no workshop confirmation.
